titleEn: OCP liquid cooling: series pressure losses and pump operating point

summary: 畫串聯元件與壓力量測位置，建立 coefficient、unit、fit_range；不得把不同流體或溫度的 K 直接混合。
summaryEn: Draw series components and pressure-tap locations, then record coefficient, unit and fit range. Do not combine coefficients measured for different fluids or temperatures without an explicit conversion or new fit.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「OCP 液冷：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: OCP liquid cooling: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 流量下降可能是管路阻力增加，也可能是泵浦供壓降低；一個流量讀值無法區別；對照泵前後壓差與分段壓差，檢查感測器零點；若供壓也變動，原本單變數實驗不成立。
名義通過 4 L/min，變更不足；選擇改善時需檢查泵功、材料與壓力限制，不能無條件加大供壓。
液冷迴路的流量取決於泵浦與管路阻抗交點；本課研究阻塞增加時的串聯模型，而非只用熱量公式反推流量。
optionsEn: Reduced flow can arise from increased resistance or reduced pump head. A single flow observation cannot distinguish these mechanisms or justify replacing a particular component. Compare pump differential pressure and component pressure drops and inspect sensor zero offsets. If supplied head also changed, label the single-variable experiment invalid rather than assigning all change to resistance.
Nominal flow meets 4 L/min and changed flow does not. Any proposed remedy must consider pump power, materials and pressure limits; the model does not authorize indiscriminately increasing pressure.
Liquid-loop flow depends on the intersection of pump capability and hydraulic resistance. Study increased series resistance rather than merely solving a heat-balance equation for a desired flow rate.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。液冷迴路的流量取決於泵浦與管路阻抗交點；本課研究阻塞增加時的串聯模型，而非只用熱量公式反推流量。 與本階段判準一起判讀：將 q=5 與 10/3 代回各元件壓降，總和均應 100；壓降不可當絕對壓力相加；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. Liquid-loop flow depends on the intersection of pump capability and hydraulic resistance. Study increased series resistance rather than merely solving a heat-balance equation for a desired flow rate. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Substitute q=5 and q=10/3 into each component’s loss and verify that totals equal 100 kPa. Distinguish pressure differences from absolute pressures when reconciling the series path. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

If supplied head also changed, label the single-variable experiment invalid rather than assigning all change to resistance.
Against the nominal OCP liquid cooling: construct traceable inputs and ownership result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Nominal flow meets 4 L/min and changed flow does not. Any proposed remedy must consider pump power, materials and pressure limits; the model does not authorize indiscriminately increasing pressure.
Reverify this criterion: Substitute q=5 and q=10/3 into each component’s loss and verify that totals equal 100 kPa. Distinguish pressure differences from absolute pressures when reconciling the series path. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。流量下降可能是管路阻力增加，也可能是泵浦供壓降低；一個流量讀值無法區別；對照泵前後壓差與分段壓差，檢查感測器零點；若供壓也變動，原本單變數實驗不成立。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Reduced flow can arise from increased resistance or reduced pump head. A single flow observation cannot distinguish these mechanisms or justify replacing a particular component. Compare pump differential pressure and component pressure drops and inspect sensor zero offsets. If supplied head also changed, label the single-variable experiment invalid rather than assigning all change to resistance.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 將 q=5 與 10/3 代回各元件壓降，總和均應 100；壓降不可當絕對壓力相加；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.checkEn: Substitute q=5 and q=10/3 into each component’s loss and verify that totals equal 100 kPa. Distinguish pressure differences from absolute pressures when reconciling the series path. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 液冷迴路的流量取決於泵浦與管路阻抗交點；本課研究阻塞增加時的串聯模型，而非只用熱量公式反推流量。
knowledge.textEn: Liquid-loop flow depends on the intersection of pump capability and hydraulic resistance. Study increased series resistance rather than merely solving a heat-balance equation for a desired flow rate.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 畫串聯元件與壓力量測位置，建立 coefficient、unit、fit_range；不得把不同流體或溫度的 K 直接混合。
knowledge.textEn: Draw series components and pressure-tap locations, then record coefficient, unit and fit range. Do not combine coefficients measured for different fluids or temperatures without an explicit conversion or new fit.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學固定壓頭 H 與二次阻力模型為 H=(K1+K2)q²，因此 q=sqrt(H/(K1+K2))；真實泵浦曲線與流態需另建模。
knowledge.textEn: With a fixed teaching head H and quadratic resistance, H=(K1+K2)q², giving q=sqrt(H/(K1+K2)). Real pump curves, fluid properties and flow regimes require separate characterization.

steps.title: OCP 液冷：建立可追溯輸入與所有權 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: OCP liquid cooling: construct traceable inputs and ownership · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「OCP 液冷：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for OCP liquid cooling: construct traceable inputs and ownership and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付兩個工作點、分段壓降、單位表與泵壓下降的替代案例；只在離線模型調整參數。
在交接件中加入「OCP 液冷：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：將 q=5 與 10/3 代回各元件壓降，總和均應 100；壓降不可當絕對壓力相加；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：畫串聯元件與壓力量測位置，建立 coefficient、unit、fit_range；不得把不同流體或溫度的 K 直接混合。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver both operating points, component losses, units and an alternative reduced-head case. Parameter changes occur only in the offline model, with no instructions to adjust physical cooling equipment.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for OCP liquid cooling: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Substitute q=5 and q=10/3 into each component’s loss and verify that totals equal 100 kPa. Distinguish pressure differences from absolute pressures when reconciling the series path. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Draw series components and pressure-tap locations, then record coefficient, unit and fit range. Do not combine coefficients measured for different fluids or temperatures without an explicit conversion or new fit. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。將 q=5 與 10/3 代回各元件壓降，總和均應 100；壓降不可當絕對壓力相加；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Substitute q=5 and q=10/3 into each component’s loss and verify that totals equal 100 kPa. Distinguish pressure differences from absolute pressures when reconciling the series path. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 將 q=5 與 10/3 代回各元件壓降，總和均應 100；壓降不可當絕對壓力相加；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.checkEn: Substitute q=5 and q=10/3 into each component’s loss and verify that totals equal 100 kPa. Distinguish pressure differences from absolute pressures when reconciling the series path. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
